in_sanskrit.name: दयाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Dayal is derived from the Sanskrit word दयाल (dayāl), which means दयातमा (dayātamā). This term is used to describe a person who is full of compassion, kind-hearted, and always willing to help others. It is a beautiful and meaningful name that reflects the qualities of love, kindness, and generosity.

It is a beautiful and meaningful name that reflects the qualities of love, kindness, and generosity.

This term is used to describe a person who embodies divine compassion and is always ready to help others. in_telugu.name: దైయోళ

It is a beautiful and meaningful name that reflects the deep spiritual and emotional significance of compassion.
